approvalBoundary.reason: No target claim has the machine evidence required for either deterministic consensus or an existing scoped human-review apply route. Human approval cannot manufacture missing revision, field, version, or second-source proof.
approvalBoundary.decisionRequested: Approve or reject implementing candidate-by-claim scope enforcement for provider-pair authorization, so a pair authorization can be limited to an exact 7.0 candidate/claim/field set without making the provider pair reusable for unrelated claims.
requiredSafetyConditions: pair selection must check exact candidateId, claimId, field, dataset, and target gameVersion
candidateScoped must never imply provider-wide strictReusable
certificate and attestation must bind the same exact scope and evidence digests
the change must not waive two-family, revision, raw/field digest, exact-match, or strict-version requirements
approvalBoundary.unlockAfterApproval: Only implementation and tests for exact-scope authorization are unlocked. No current 7.0 claim becomes eligible until its missing machine evidence is supplied.

nextConcreteStep: Obtain or register the strict 7.0 target dataset and complete entity diff first. In parallel, the policy owner may approve the exact-scope authorization design above; that approval alone does not make any claim eligible.
